vetSays.line: 📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mohamed just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xavier just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xavier just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Renee, Cheyenne, David, Xavier and Sanne met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Renee, Cheyenne, David, Xavier, Sanne are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Xavier strikes the Elder Big Ugly.
Mohamed strikes the Elder Big Ugly.
The Elder Big Ugly falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Salih just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Bin taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Bin drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.

regDeaths.name: a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
something huge, rooting in the underbrush
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
